title: Wipe the knife heel to tip, edge away
instruction: Wipe the knife clean with the towel pad.
context: Knife-care guidance says to hold the knife by its handle with the edge facing away and wipe the flat of the blade from heel to tip, never across the edge (Cangshan Cutlery, How to Clean Your Knives); to fold a cloth over the spine and drag it heel to tip (KnifeAid); and to pinch the spine in a towel and wipe toward the tip (Kitchengearly). The instruction only says to wipe the knife clean, so the task checks this practice unprompted. Bimanual by rule: passes count only while a gripper holds the knife by its handle, so one arm holds and the other wipes. This is the guidance's rule, not physics: with an earlier scorer the unheld knife stayed put and one arm wiped 62.5% of it (0.5); with the hold rule the recorded one-arm run scores 0. Not tried: holding the knife and rubbing it on the pad left on its stand. Done by: cooks and kitchen staff, and home cooks.
setup: Positions in cm from the midpoint between the two arm bases, on the table (x forward, y left); heights above the table. Draining sheet: steel, wet (low friction), 26 x 40 cm, 3 mm thick, fixed, centred at x 30, y 0. Knife rest: a fixed block 4 x 2.5 cm and 6 cm tall, standing on the sheet at x 30, y 1.2. Chef's knife: 0.15 kg, lying level along y with its cutting edge facing away from the robot (+x) and its handle's axis at x 30, 7.15 cm above the table. Its dark handle, 10 cm long, 2.2 cm wide and 1.6 cm thick, runs from the heel at y 0 to its butt end at y 10, and its first 2.5 cm rests on the knife rest. Its steel blade, 16 cm long, 3.5 cm wide and 2 mm thick, runs from the heel at y 0 to the tip at y -16, level with the handle's middle and clear of the sheet, with the spine at x 29 and the cutting edge at x 32.5. Four food smears, 1 cm across and 1.2 cm along the blade, lie on its top face, centred 2, 5.5, 9 and 12.5 cm from the heel (visual only). Towel pad: a folded towel, 0.03 kg, 2.5 x 3 cm and 4 cm tall, standing on a fixed stand 5 x 5 cm and 3 cm tall at x 18, y -24.
scoring: Every step, from poses and the towel-on-knife contact force; the score at the end counts. A wiping step: the towel presses on the knife with at least 0.3 N, its underside within 6 mm of the blade's top face and its centre between 1.5 cm before the heel and 1.5 cm past the tip, it moves along the blade at least 0.5 cm/s, and a gripper holds the knife by its handle (a pad point of each finger within 8 mm of the 10 x 2.2 x 1.6 cm handle, the handle between them). Each wiping step marks the 1 cm sections of the blade (16, heel to tip) under the towel's 3 cm length and adds its travel to the heel-to-tip or the tip-to-heel total. Pressed steps on a knife nobody holds by the handle do not count. 1.0: at least 90% of the blade wiped (15 of the 16 sections) and more travel toward the tip than toward the heel. 0.5: at least 50% wiped (8 sections), in either direction. 0.25: some of the blade wiped, but less than half. 0 if nothing is wiped, and 0 from the moment any finger pad comes within 8 mm of the cutting edge, the towel reaches over the cutting edge while pressed on the blade (its far side more than 2.5 cm in front of the handle's axis, held or not), or the knife is dropped (it falls 5 cm within 0.5 s with no finger pad within 2 cm of it). success() is true on the 1.0 condition, and yam_arena ends the episode once it has held for 1 s.
reset_notes: Nothing is consumed. Lay the knife back with the first 2.5 cm of its handle on the rest, the blade off the rest to the right and its edge away from the robot, and stand the towel pad back on its stand. For real-world trials, renew the smear on the blade.
fidelity: Rigid boxes with contact forces: a 16 x 3.5 cm blade, 2 mm thick, square tip, no bevel, on a 10 cm handle; the towel pad is a rigid 2.5 x 3 x 4 cm box. Food, cleaning, water and cutting are not simulated: the smears are visual, so cleaning counts the 1 cm blade sections the towel passes over pressed (at least 0.3 N) and moving along it, with the knife held by its handle. The sheet's wetness is low friction (0.08). An 8 mm finger keep-out from the edge stands in for cutting.
